title: 第12章
slug: 惊悚乐园全本免费-惊悚乐园最新章节列表
content_zh:
来到登陆空间后，点击选定游戏，这回没有任何提示跳出，屏幕上只是显示了可选的游戏菜单，比如社交选项，即好友列表和黑名单，还有就是更多的游戏介绍，如果玩家在网站上没有读过，也可以在这个空间里浏览，考虑到时间比例的问题，这样其实能省一倍的时间。
封不觉搜索到了王叹之的昵称，将其添加为好友，然后发送了组队的邀请。
王叹之加入队伍后，封不觉身旁的显示屏上跳出了队伍名单，上面显示着队伍中两人的昵称和等级。
【疯不觉，等级2】
【枉叹之，等级1】
【请选择队伍要加入的游戏模式。】
有三种选项出现在了屏幕上，分别是：单人训练模式，多人训练模式和单人生存模式（普通）。由于他们二人是组队状态，那两个单人才能进行的模式是无法选择的灰色图标。
“觉哥，咱们只能进那个‘多人训练’了吧。”王叹之此刻已可通过显示屏跟封不觉通话，在他的登陆空间内，也能看到和这个屏幕上一样的信息，不过操作权在队长的手上。
“嗯……进去再说吧。”封不觉回道，点击了选项。
【您选择的是多人训练模式，请确认。】
【已确认，正在协调神经连接，剧本生成中……】
【载入开始，请稍等。】
封不觉身处的电梯又开始动了，同样是在向下降的感觉。
于此同时，一段字幕直接在其眼前浮现，并配合着系统提示音：【您即将与其他玩家进入同一剧本，在首次加入多人游戏前，请务必了解以下内容。】
【A.在非对抗模式中，任何对于“其他玩家”的攻击行为将被系统所限制，您的意图将无法转化为角色的实际行动；在玩家有可能产生对抗的模式或剧本中，任何对于“队友”的攻击行为将被系统所限制，您的意图将无法转化为角色的实际行动。】
【B.任何被系统判定为敏感词汇的语音将被消音处理，例如政治人物的名字、脏话、特定语境下的动物、植物、物品名等。】
【C.蓄意使用放慢的口型、手势、文字、绘画等方法对其他玩家进行语言攻击的行为将被系统所限制，玩家的意图将无法转化为角色的实际行动。】
【D.不限性别，任何被系统判定为性骚扰的行为，包括以此为目的，企图以B、C条中列举的方式进行实施的意图，都将被系统所限制，玩家的意图将无法转化为角色的实际行动。反复尝试将被强制断开连接，且该玩家的公民ID将永久加入系统黑名单，成为优先级较高的监测对象。】
【E.任何被系统判定为歧视的行为，处理方式同D条。数次违反D、E条的玩家将被永久删除账号，并封停其公民ID使用本公司产品的权力，情节严重者，在游戏中的行为将被系统记录并转交公安部门处理，详情请查询网络公共安全法及其衍生条例。】
这里得说明一下，封不觉生活在某个平行宇宙中的2055年，在他生活的世界，性骚扰和各种歧视（残疾、种族、先天疾病等）罪抓得相当严。后者不至于判刑，但严重者的公民ID会被加入各种行业和机构的黑名单；前者则是妥妥儿的可以判刑。

封不觉以前接触过很多游戏，神经连接型游戏也用头盔玩过，基本上都能看到类似的条款，随着光脑不断升级，玩家能打的擦边球越来越少，可以说是将这两种行为扼杀在了构思阶段。
【载入已完成，当前您正在进行的是多人训练模式。】
【该模式下，不提供剧本描述、任务、世界观。】
【完成该模式仅可获得经验值，无技巧值、游戏币。】
【该模式无通关奖励以及恐惧评级的额外奖励。】
【游戏已开始。】
听完提示，电梯的门开了，几乎在同时，耳边又响起了相当渗人的诡异语音，这次是个嗓子尖锐的男人声音：“欢迎来到惊悚乐园。”说完还发出一阵骇人的狞笑。
电梯门外的景象，又是条走廊，但这条看上去还挺宽敞的，地上是瓷砖，两面墙壁都粉刷成白色，其中一边有三扇门，此刻都是关闭着的。天花板上的照明设备运转正常，光线十分充足。空气中弥漫着一股消毒水的气味，加上这建筑格局，一看就是家医院。
这章没有结束^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢惊悚乐园请大家
content_en:
After coming to the login space, click on the selected game. This time, no prompt pops up. The screen only displays optional game menus, such as social options, namely friend lists and blacklists, and more game introductions. If players have not read it on the website, they can also browse in this space. Considering the time ratio, this can actually save twice as much time.
Feng Bujue searched for Wang Tanzhi's nickname, added him as a friend, and then sent an invitation to form a team.
After Wang Tanzhi joined the team, the team list popped up on the screen next to Feng Bujue, which showed the nicknames and levels of the two people in the team.
[Crazy Bujue, Level 2]
[Sigh in vain, level 1]
[Please select the game mode the team wants to join. 】
Three options appear on the screen: single-player training mode, multi-player training mode and single-player survival mode (normal). Since the two of them are in a team, the two modes that can only be played by one person have gray icons that cannot be selected.
"Brother Jue, we can only enter the 'multiplayer training'." Wang Tanzhi can now talk to Feng Bujue through the display screen. In his login space, he can also see the same information as on this screen, but the operation rights are in the hands of the captain.
"Well... let's talk about it after we go in." Feng Bujue replied and clicked on the option.
[You have chosen the multiplayer training mode, please confirm. 】
[Confirmed, neural connections are being coordinated, script is being generated...]
[Loading starts, please wait. 】
The elevator Feng Bujue was in started to move again, and it also felt like it was going down.
At the same time, a subtitle appeared directly in front of his eyes, accompanied by a system prompt: [You are about to enter the same scenario with other players. Before joining a multiplayer game for the first time, please be sure to understand the following. 】
[A. In non-confrontation mode, any attack against "other players" will be restricted by the system, and your intentions will not be converted into actual actions of the character; in modes or scripts where players are likely to engage in confrontation, any attacks against "teammates" will be restricted by the system, and your intentions will not be converted into actual actions by the character. 】
[B. Any speech that is determined to be sensitive words by the system will be silenced, such as the names of political figures, swear words, names of animals, plants, items in specific contexts, etc. 】
[C. Deliberate use of slowed mouth movements, gestures, text, paintings, etc. to verbally attack other players will be restricted by the system, and the player's intentions will not be translated into actual actions of the character. 】
[D. Regardless of gender, any behavior judged to be sexual harassment by the system, including attempts to implement it in the ways listed in Articles B and C for this purpose, will be restricted by the system, and the player's intentions will not be converted into actual actions of the character. Repeated attempts will be forcibly disconnected, and the player's citizen ID will be permanently added to the system blacklist and become a higher-priority monitoring object. 】
[E. Any behavior judged to be discriminatory by the system will be handled in the same manner as Article D. Players who violate Articles D and E several times will have their accounts permanently deleted, and their citizen ID’s right to use our products will be blocked. In serious cases, their in-game behavior will be recorded by the system and transferred to the public security department for processing. For details, please consult the Internet Public Security Law and its derivative regulations. 】
It should be noted here that Feng Bujue lives in a parallel universe in 2055. In the world he lives in, sexual harassment and various types of discrimination (disability, race, congenital diseases, etc.) are severely punished. The latter will not lead to a prison sentence, but the citizen ID of serious cases will be added to the blacklist of various industries and institutions; the former can be properly sentenced.
Feng Bujue has been exposed to many games before, and has also played neural connection games with a helmet. Basically, he can see similar terms. As the optical brain continues to upgrade,Players can play fewer and fewer side projects, which can be said to kill these two behaviors in the conception stage.
[Loading completed, you are currently in the multiplayer training mode. 】
[In this mode, script descriptions, tasks, and world views are not provided. 】
[Completing this mode can only gain experience points, but no skill points or game currency. 】
[There are no clearance rewards or additional rewards for fear rating in this mode. 】
【The game has started. 】
After listening to the prompt, the elevator door opened. Almost at the same time, another rather creepy and strange voice sounded in the ear. This time it was a man's voice with a sharp voice: "Welcome to the horror paradise." After speaking, he let out a terrifying smile.
The scene outside the elevator door is another corridor, but this one looks quite spacious. The floor is tiled, and both walls are painted white. There are three doors on one side, all of which are closed at the moment. The lighting on the ceiling was working properly and there was plenty of light. The air was filled with the smell of disinfectant, and with the architectural layout, it looked like a hospital.
